note: Warm start: Julsgaard's 81920-cell certificate (teorth/optimizationproblems pull request 312, sha256 04c9c75909b70c215c312e85ef14679d90bc7f98257749c75f422d33048f7237). Each cell split in two (163840 cells); L-BFGS polish of log ||v*v||_p - 2 log S at p = 1e8 to 1e11, then restarts of the p-norm continuation from the best vector, p doubled up to about 7e10: from p = 32 on a Kaggle T4 GPU, then from p = 32, 16 and 64 on one CPU core, 8 Nov 2026 (this is the p = 64 restart).
